title: mut.channel_stiles_words_beyond_words
mutation_directive: Sasha Stiles — WORDS BEYOND WORDS / Cursive Binary — WORDS BEYOND WORDS (Lumen Prize 2025 Literature & Poetry winner); Cursive Binary (ongoing); Technelegy (2021). VISUAL SIGNATURE: An infinite scrolling poem: glyphs that are halfway between calligraphy and binary code; English letters dissolving into 0/1 streams and back; typography as moving form. Black ink on cream, or luminous text in 3D space. Language-as-particle. TECHNICAL HOOKS for three.js / GLSL: Each particle = a single Unicode glyph rendered as an SDF texture atlas (msdfgen). Particles stream along a 3D Bezier curve like a Kafkaesque ribbon; periodically a glyph 'collapses' into a row of 0/1 binary digits, then re-coalesces. Use a custom GLSL vertex shader to bend the typographic ribbon. Audio-reactive: text density modulated by user speech amplitude. Palette: ink-black on cream, or ghost-white on void. WHY DIVERSE: Pool has zero typography / language as form. Adds a literary modality entirely: particles that ARE characters, not abstract shapes. Also references the user's recent Lumen vault interest. Stay faithful to the visual signature; pick whatever three.js primitives are needed (Lines2 / InstancedMesh / SphereGeometry / custom ShaderMaterial) — but the FORM should read as if this artist made it. REF: https://lumenprize.org/2025-winners
